shots.text: The model assigned AAPL a BUY with an overall score of 72/100 because fundamentals and technicals scored relatively high while sentiment was more mixed. The listed signals point to solid cash generation and constructive price momentum, offset partly by valuation pressure mentioned in the signals. This is for educational purposes only and is not financial advice.

shots.text: The model rated XOM as HOLD (58/100) because the rule-based scores are split: fundamentals and sentiment do not strongly align, and the signals highlight macro-driven volatility and mixed read-through from the data provided.
